heroHeadline: Machado Holds First Mass Rally Since Returning to Venezuela, Presses Interim Government for Election Date
heroSubtitle: Addressing thousands of students in Caracas on Nov 25, María Corina Machado promised a transition 'without vengeance' and demanded a date for free elections from the US-backed interim government of Delcy Rodríguez.
